module_summary: MII Ethernet MAC wrapper: a 10/100 MII MAC instance sits between dual-clock AXI-stream TX and RX FIFOs, with toggle synchronizers bringing MAC error pulses into logic_clk.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-stream payload entering the TX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit stream valid into TX FIFO slave port.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: TX FIFO ready back-pressure to the transmit source.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received frame payload output from the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: RX FIFO output valid for received stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling RX FIFO reads.

anchors.name: mii_rxd
anchors.why: MII receive nibble from PHY into the MAC.

anchors.name: mii_txd
anchors.why: MII transmit nibble driven by the MAC to the PHY.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: TX FIFO output stream feeding MAC transmit input in tx_clk domain.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid from TX FIFO to MAC transmit path.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: MAC receive stream written into the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: MAC receive valid writing the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Synchronized TX underflow pulse decoded from toggle synchronizer registers.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Synchronized RX bad-frame pulse from toggle synchronizer.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Synchronized RX bad-FCS pulse from toggle synchronizer bit 1.

anchors.name: tx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: Toggle register in tx_clk flipping on each underflow event for CDC.

anchors.name: rx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: Toggle register in rx_clk capturing bad frame/FCS events for CDC.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: TX FIFO overflow status from FIFO slave side.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: RX FIFO overflow status from FIFO master side.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap configuration passed to the MAC.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC transmit path.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC receive path.

groups.name: tx_fifo
groups.description: Async AXI-stream FIFO moving transmit frames from logic_clk to MAC tx_clk.

groups.name: mii_mac
groups.description: 10/100 MAC with MII PHY adapter converting frames to nibble streams.

groups.name: rx_fifo
groups.description: Async AXI-stream FIFO moving received frames from rx_clk to logic_clk.

groups.name: status_sync
groups.description: Toggle synchronizers moving MAC error pulses into logic_clk.
